description.p: emobie is a compact emoji palette for Linux. Search the full Unicode set, favorite what you use most, copy with one click, pin the window above other apps, and summon it from a global hotkey or the system tray.
Resize freely between horizontal, square, and vertical layouts. Preferences cover theme, emoji size, skin tone, recent history, sort order, and hotkey.

description.p: More reliable Expand on Plasma Wayland: hybrid key/clipboard insert, no clipboard restore by default, and safer helper bootstrap.
Wayland Expand via /dev/uinput, smoke checklist tooling, and LOC module splits for CI.
Text-expansion reliability: safer pending/release handling, inject-worker recovery, match/socket hardening, and layout-aware XKB reload.
Harden Expand Grant across packages: permanent group/udev checks, full AppImage asset staging, and idempotent setup repair.
Full-surface audit fixes: inputd hardening, safer Grant/update paths, Expand IPC cleanup, and preference sync improvements.
Favorite emoji macros, emoticon style setting, inputd preferences bootstrap, and AppImage WebKit bundling fix.
Layout-aware text expansion, seamless AppImage/Flatpak helper install, and SELinux auto-setup during Grant.
Cross-distro text expansion permissions, Wayland inject fix, and verify-expand-setup diagnostic script.
Durable preferences across install channels, Wayland taskbar icon via matching GTK app id, and full hicolor icons in Linux packages.
In-app updater, Ubuntu typeface, Linux distro/DE coverage (pin, Flatpak autostart, AppImage linuxdeploy fix), and text-expansion polish.
Normalize branding to lowercase emobie, including the Flatpak app id, and ship macros with the host input helper.
Ship .rpm and AppImage packages on GitHub Releases alongside .deb and Flatpak.
Lifecycle reliability: tray-aware quit, cold-start without flash, multi-instance setting, and audit polish across settings and chrome.
Fix Flatpak launch-on-startup, avoid invisible start-minimized without a tray, and focus a single instance on relaunch.
Startup options, emoji sort preference, frameless resize cursors, and a fixed pin button frame.
Fix frameless window dragging from the toolbar.
Frameless by default, compact toolbar with always-available pin/settings, and emobie branding.
Doesbie branding, looser hotkeys, and left-click tray show via StatusNotifierItem.
Hide the category strip scrollbar so icons stay fully visible.
Fix Flatpak startup crash by bundling Ayatana AppIndicator for the system tray.
Migrate Flatpak runtime to supported GNOME Platform 50.
First Flatpak-ready release.
